def main(width, height, cells, player, boxes, moves):
    boxes = list(boxes)
    w = width
    delta = [-w, 1, w, -1]
    hist = []
    read = pushes = blocked = undos = dead = 0
    for m in moves:
        if all(cells[b] == 2 for b in boxes):
            break
        read += 1
        if m == 4:
            if hist:
                dirn, k = hist.pop()
                dl = delta[dirn]
                if k >= 0:
                    boxes[k] = player
                player -= dl
                undos += 1
            continue
        dl = delta[m]
        t = player + dl
        if cells[t] == 1:
            blocked += 1
            continue
        if t in boxes:
            k = boxes.index(t)
            u = t + dl
            if cells[u] == 1 or u in boxes:
                blocked += 1
                continue
            boxes[k] = u
            player = t
            pushes += 1
            if (cells[u] != 2
                    and (cells[u - w] == 1 or cells[u + w] == 1)
                    and (cells[u - 1] == 1 or cells[u + 1] == 1)):
                dead += 1
            hist.append((m, k))
        else:
            player = t
            hist.append((m, -1))
    solved = all(cells[b] == 2 for b in boxes)
    return (player, boxes, read, len(hist), pushes, blocked, undos, dead, solved)
